Sobre a vaga

Job Summary:

We are looking for an experienced AI/ML Engineer with 8+ years of overall experience and 5+ years in building and deploying production-grade AI solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, and model lifecycle management, along with hands-on experience integrating AI models into web applications via APIs.

Key Skills:

  • AI frameworks: LangChain, Spring AI, Strands
  • Python (strong), working knowledge of Java & JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Prompt engineering, RAG, guardrails, and evaluations
  • Model monitoring, performance optimization, and drift detection
  • LLM observability tools
  • Feature engineering & ML lifecycle management
  • Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and OOP

Responsibilities:

  • Build, deploy, and scale AI/ML and LLM-based solutions
  • Integrate models with web applications via APIs
  • Monitor model performance and ensure reliability in production
  • Debug, optimize, and troubleshoot AI services
  • Follow best practices: clean code, testing, Git, and code reviews

Please share the copy of resume at dhirendra@otyms.com if interested.

Cheers,

Dhirendra Pathak
